title: Instant Breaker
description: This mod Adds a instant Break toggle for Singleplayer and Singleplayer ONLY and works for Hardcore Survival And Creative "NOT ON MULTIPLAYER"
body:
A SinglePlayer mod that adds toggable instant break for any block except Unbreakable blocks, This works with the items like pickaxe, sword and axe

The Default keybind for toggling is <8> if not used already else you have to change the input in the Keybind settings.
